Welcome! This site collects my CV, selected projects, and the notes and tutorials I have written over the years.

I spent more than five years at ECOM Trading, one of the world's largest merchants of coffee, cotton and cocoa, where I rose to lead the data science team in the Research department. There I built price forecasting models, trading signals, weather and crop-yield models, and a global deforestation risk model, all used to support trading decisions.

Before that, I designed data science training for blue-chip companies at Decoded, worked on real-time disease modelling at UCL, and completed a DPhil in Plant Sciences at the University of Oxford.

**Next step:** since late 2024 I have moved into commodities analysis, applying fundamental, weather, macro and quantitative analysis to agricultural markets.

Outside work, you will usually find me in the gym, hiking, or travelling.
